US8509827B2.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

Context-Data Acquisition And Ranking.description: A method and system in which a context-data type is determined from a query, context-data sources providing that type are identified, a request for context data is generated, and received context data is ranked according to a specified parameter.

Short Message.description: A message received from a mobile device by a server, whose term meaning is used to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, and forwarded along with the short message.

Mobile Device.description: A device that generates a short message and query; context data may be provided to it, and it may be a recipient mobile device receiving context data.

Server.description: A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.

Context-Data Type.description: A type of context data determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

Context-Data Source.description: A source that provides a context-data type and from which context data of that type is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

Context Data.description: Data of a determined context-data type received from a context-data source, which may be ranked, provided to devices, associated with a short message component, appended, encoded, stored, or forwarded.

Specified Parameter.description: A parameter used to rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.

Recipient Mobile Device.description: A mobile device that receives context data, to which received context data and forwarded short messages may be provided.

Database.description: A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

Database Server.description: A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.

Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).description: An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.

Markup Language.description: A language used to encode received context data into the short message.

Metadata Instructions.description: Instructions appended to the short message to query the database for the received context data.

Pecuniary Cost.description: A cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

Communication Network.description: An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.
